blocks.h2: Garbage Disposals in Lincoln Park Kitchens
blocks.intro: In shared buildings, a disposal clog can affect more than your sink.

items.body: Food waste from several kitchens ends up in the same stack.
Older pipe clogs faster with ground food.

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: In a building where several kitchens share one drain, what goes down your disposal can show up in a neighbor's sink. Run cold water, feed food slowly and keep grease, rice, pasta and coffee grounds out. If the building has frequent kitchen line clogs, the board may want the line jetted on a schedule. We can help with both.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of a Disposal Job
blocks.body: A straight swap is quick. A first-time install in a condo may need an outlet and drain changes. If the shared kitchen line is slow, clearing it first helps. We check and quote one flat price.

blocks.h2: Garbage Disposal Questions From Lincoln Park Homeowners

items.q: Can my disposal clog the building's drain?
items.preview: It can, with the wrong foods.
items.answer: It can. Grease, fibrous food and coffee grounds build up in shared lines.

items.q: My disposal just hums. What now?
items.preview: Turn it off. It's likely jammed.
items.answer: Turn it off and try the reset button and the hex key under the unit. If it won't turn, call us.

items.q: Can you install a disposal in my condo?
items.answer: Usually. Some buildings restrict disposals, so check with your association.

items.q: Should I repair or replace it?
items.preview: If it leaks from the body or is old, replace it.
items.answer: If the housing leaks or it's more than about 10 years old, replacing it usually makes more sense.

items.q: Is a quieter disposal worth it?
items.answer: In a condo with shared walls, a sound-insulated model is often worth it.

items.q: Why does my disposal trip the breaker?
items.preview: A jam or a failing motor.
items.answer: Usually a jam or a motor at the end of its life.

items.q: How much does garbage disposal replacement cost in Lincoln Park?
items.preview: It depends on the unit. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the unit and connections. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
